name: Gasthof Lobewein
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Lobewein in Ellmau**

Welcome to **Gasthof Lobewein**, a cozy and family-run inn nestled in the heart of **Ellmau**, a picturesque village in the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming retreat offers warm hospitality and authentic Tyrolean charm.

Indulge in traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Käsespätzle**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all made with locally sourced ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a smooth **Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

After dining, relax in our rustic lounge or take a stroll through the snow-covered trails of the **Kitzbühel Alps**. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Gasthof Lobewein** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.
